recognize_zh: 黏膜組織中，瀰漫的中型至大型非典型淋巴細胞浸潤於殘存腺體之間，核形不規則、深染並伴有散在凋亡碎屑；結外（鼻腔）黏膜部位的瀰漫非典型淋巴浸潤是結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤的線索，但確診需 CD56、細胞毒性標記與 EBER。
features: Diffuse dense infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells in mucosa
Irregular, angulated to elongated hyperchromatic nuclei with coarse to granular chromatin
Infiltrate surrounds and separates residual mucous glands, with focal glandular infiltration
Scattered apoptotic bodies and nuclear debris; a thick-walled vessel coursing through the infiltrate
describe_en: Section of mucosa (consistent with sinonasal-type mucosa) shows a diffuse, dense infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells that surround and separate residual seromucinous glands. The cells have irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei with granular chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm; scattered apoptotic bodies are present. Angiocentric destruction and zonal necrosis are not clearly demonstrated in this field. Findings are suggestive of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, pending confirmation with CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers and EBER in situ hybridization.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are usually larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5, being EBER and CD56 negative in most cases.
PTCL-NOS lacks the combined CD56/cytotoxic/EBER-positive profile that defines ENKTL.

ddx.dx: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis or reactive/infectious sinusitis
ddx.vs: Inflammatory lesions show a polymorphous infiltrate with neutrophils, granulomas or organisms rather than a sheet of cytologically atypical lymphocytes, and are EBER negative.

ddx.dx: Rhabdomyosarcoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Non-hematolymphoid small round cell tumors are CD45 negative and express lineage markers such as desmin/myogenin or keratin.
